cases.title: Confirm loaded village
steps: Before this case, load the first occupied hunter from the supplied save copy and wait for the village.
Use that same hunter slot and the same input device in both roles.
Leave controls idle for two seconds. Open Yakumo's menu with Esc or L3+R3, choose Test session, and begin this case.
Check that the hunter and village remain visible. Do not move, change equipment, or enter a quest.
Open Test session, record Village visible, then reopen it and mark your outcome.

cases.title: Village input and menu
steps: Start in the village after REC-01; begin this case in Test session.
Hold W or left stick up for two seconds, then release for two.
Hold A or left stick left for one second, then release. Stop early at a wall or door; do not retry or enter it.
Hold J or right stick left for one second, then release. Observe the camera.
Open Yakumo's menu with Esc or L3+R3; record Movement and camera done in Test session.
Open Yakumo's menu again; press Down then Up once with arrow keys or D-pad, then close it.
Reopen Test session; record Menu round trip. Reopen it again to mark your outcome.

cases.title: Village native helper coverage
steps: Begin in the village where REC-02 ended, with the same hunter and unchanged equipment.
Look at the hunter's model and outfit or weapon. Do not change equipment or enter a quest.
Hold W or left stick up for two seconds, then release for two.
Hold D or left stick right for one second, release, then wait three seconds. Stop early at a wall or door; do not retry or enter it.
Open Test session; record Native route finished, then reopen it and mark your outcome.

cases.title: Complete recording and close
steps: After NATIVE-01 has an outcome, begin this case in Test session while the village remains visible.
Stay still and do not change settings. Reopen Test session and record Ready to close.
Reopen Test session and mark your outcome.
Only after this case has ended, close the game window normally and wait for collection.
